name: M0ther//B04rd
source:
In a dusty basement, a ratty programmer tinkers away at an android she had managed to scrounge up from the dump.  A model this old is barely worth the parts it was made out of nowadays. They don't even have the necessary chips to be able to run a self-conscious schematic that the government always is getting up in arms about.

It's a good thing Lydia doesn't care about any of that. Limitations are meant to be overcome, after all. With just a bit of elbow grease and know-how, this tin can is going to behave exactly how she wants it to.

[From [url=https://onymonch.itch.io/motherboard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个布满灰尘的地下室里，一个破烂的程序员正在修补她从垃圾场里捡来的一个机器人。这么旧的模型几乎不值现在制造的零件。他们甚至没有必要的芯片来运行政府总是对此感到愤怒的自觉示意图。

幸好莉迪亚不在乎这些。毕竟，限制是要被克服的。只需一点点努力和专业知识，这个锡罐就能完全按照她想要的方式运行。

[来自[url=https://onymonch.itch.io/motherboard]itch.io[/url]]
